description: Students analyze mechanical principles in depth as they affect human motion. Topics include study of muscular and skeletal systems, skill analysis, and motion measurement techniques. Students attend lectures plus one three-hour laboratory per week. Offered annually. Prerequisites: BIO 143, BIO 243, and junior status.
name: Biomechanics
notes: Students in KINES 374B must also register for KINES 374B lab.
This course is open to rising seniors and juniors.
